description: MUTATES A LIVE ORDER. Partially update an existing order by id — e.g. change status, fulfillment, or notes. Provide the id plus a `fields` object of attributes to change, e.g. {"status":"complete"}. Swell backend REST API: PUT /orders/{id}.

fields.description: Partial set of order attributes to update, e.g. {"status":"complete"} or fulfillment fields.

name: swell_update_order
title: Update an order
